To advance the deal, we can reject the proposed 15-day deadline and retain 30 days but accept New York law. We will update the governing law clause accordingly, remove the 30-day tracked change and replace with 30-day deadline (non-tracked, as no opposing tracked change), and set governing law to New York (accepting the proposed change). We will send a conciliatory message to opposing counsel emphasizing our client's need for 30 days payment but agreeing to New York law to show flexibility. We will delete the existing tracked change for Delaware governing law and replace it with New York governing law as a new tracked change (to show movement).
